units.source_text: 今日是试演之日。

en.t: Today was the day of the rehearsal.

units.source_text: 但因诸位夫人都来观赏，故表演者也要打扮得好看些。

en.t: But since all the ladies had come to watch, the performers too had to dress more beautifully.

units.source_text: 贺寿当日，舞童应穿灰褐色礼服和淡紫色衬袍。

en.t: On the day of the birthday celebration, the child dancers were to wear gray-brown ceremonial robes with pale purple under-robes.

units.source_text: 今日则穿青色礼服和暗红色衬袍。

en.t: Today, however, they wore blue ceremonial robes and dark red under-robes.

units.source_text: 三十个乐人，今日都穿白衣服。

en.t: The thirty musicians were all dressed in white today.

units.source_text: 乐队设在与东南院的钓殿连接的廊房中。

en.t: The orchestra was placed in the gallery connected to the fishing pavilion of the southeastern wing.

units.source_text: 从假山南端出发，走向源氏面前，一路上演奏《仙游霞》之曲。

en.t: They set out from the southern end of the artificial hill and proceeded toward Genji, playing the piece "Senyuuka" along the way.

units.source_text: 其时空中疏疏地飘下几点瑞雪，令人想见不久即将腊尽春回。

en.t: At that moment a few auspicious flakes of snow drifted sparsely from the sky, making one feel that the year would soon end and spring return.

units.source_text: 梅花也已含苞欲放了。

en.t: The plum blossoms too were already in bud and about to open.

units.source_text: 源氏坐在厢房帘内，只有紫夫人的父亲式部卿亲王和髭黑右大臣二人奉陪，其余王侯公卿都坐在廊下。

en.t: Genji sat behind the blinds in the side chamber, attended only by Lady Murasaki's father, Prince Shikibukyo, and the Right Minister Higekuro, while the other princes and nobles sat below the gallery.

units.source_text: 今日不是正式贺寿，故并不安排盛筵，只是寻常招待。

en.t: Since today was not the formal birthday celebration, no grand banquet was arranged, only ordinary hospitality.

units.source_text: 髭黑右大臣家玉鬘夫人所生四公子、夕雾大将家云居雁夫人所生三公子，以及萤兵部卿亲王家的两位王孙儿子，共舞《万岁乐》。

en.t: The fourth son born to Lady Tamakazura of Right Minister Higekuro's house, the third son born to Lady Kumoi no Kari of General Yugiri's house, and the two royal grandsons of Prince Hotaru Hyobukyo danced "Manzairaku" together.

units.source_text: 大家年纪都还很小，姿态非常可爱。

en.t: They were all still very young, and their bearing was utterly charming.

units.source_text: 此四人都是富贵之家的子弟，都长得眉清目秀，打扮得衣冠楚楚，想是观者胸有成见之故，都觉得异常高贵。

en.t: These four were all children of noble and wealthy houses; they were handsome and finely dressed, and perhaps because the viewers were already disposed to admire them, everyone found them extraordinarily noble.

units.source_text: 还有，夕雾大将家惟光的女儿典侍所生二公子和式部卿亲王家的公子——前任兵卫督、现称为源中纳言的——二人共舞《皇麞》，

en.t: In addition, the second son born to the Naishi, Koremitsu's daughter in General Yugiri's household, and the son of Prince Shikibukyo, formerly Captain of the Palace Guards and now known as Minamoto Chunagon, danced "Ojo" together,

units.source_text: 髭黑右大将家玉鬘夫人所生三公子舞《陵王》，夕雾右大臣家云居雁夫人所生大公子舞《落蹲》。

en.t: the third son born to Lady Tamakazura of Right General Higekuro's house danced "Ryo-o," and the eldest son born to Lady Kumoi no Kari of Right Minister Yugiri's house danced "Rakuson."

units.source_text: 此外又有《太平乐》《喜春乐》等，都由源氏一族中的公子及大人表演。

en.t: There were also pieces such as "Taiheiraku" and "Kishunraku," all performed by young lords and adults of Genji's clan.

units.source_text: 天色渐暮，源氏命人把帘子卷起，便觉另有一般美景，诸孙儿的容貌实在艳丽，舞姿新奇可贵。

en.t: As dusk gradually fell, Genji ordered the blinds to be rolled up, and the scene took on a different beauty; the grandchildren's faces were truly lovely, and their dancing was fresh and precious.

units.source_text: 这是因为舞师、乐师悉心教练，各尽所能；

en.t: This was because the dance masters and musicians had trained them with great care, each doing his utmost;

units.source_text: 又加了夕雾与柏木的精深博雅的指导，所以舞姿特别美妙。

en.t: and because Yugiri and Kashiwagi had added their profound and refined guidance, the dancing was especially beautiful.

units.source_text: 源氏觉得处处都很可爱。

en.t: Genji found everything about it delightful.

units.source_text: 王侯公卿中年纪较大的人，都感动得流下泪来。

en.t: The older men among the princes and high nobles were all moved to tears.

units.source_text: 式部卿亲王看了孙儿辈的舞姿，欢喜之泪流个不住，鼻子都发红了。

en.t: Prince Shikibukyo watched the dances of his grandchildren and could not stop shedding tears of joy, until even his nose turned red.

units.source_text: 源氏言道：“年纪一大，便经不起感动，容易流眼泪。

en.t: Genji said, "Once one grows old, one cannot withstand emotion and tears come easily.

units.source_text: 卫门督注视着我微笑，使我觉得很难为情。

en.t: The Captain of the Gate Guards looks at me and smiles, which makes me feel quite embarrassed.

units.source_text: 须知你的青春是暂时的！

en.t: You should know that your youth is only temporary!

units.source_text: 年光不会倒流，谁也逃不了衰老呢！”

en.t: Time will not flow backward, and no one can escape old age!"

units.source_text: 说着，向柏木注视。

en.t: As he said this, he looked intently at Kashiwagi.

units.source_text: 柏木的神情显然比别人消沉，他心中实在非常苦闷，连这种优美的舞蹈也无心欣赏。

en.t: Kashiwagi's expression was plainly more downcast than anyone else's; his heart was truly in anguish, and he had no mind even to enjoy such beautiful dancing.

units.source_text: 如今源氏装着醉态，特地点他的名说这番话，看来似乎是开玩笑，却使得他心中更加难过。

en.t: Now Genji, pretending to be drunk, deliberately named him and spoke these words; they seemed like a joke, but they made Kashiwagi feel even more distressed.

units.source_text: 酒杯巡回到他面前时，他只觉得头痛，举杯略微沾唇，就此混蒙过去。

en.t: When the wine cup came around to him, he felt only a headache; he raised the cup, barely touched it to his lips, and then drifted into a daze.

units.source_text: 源氏看了大为不满，一定要他拿住酒杯，屡次劝他饮干。

en.t: Seeing this, Genji was greatly displeased and insisted that he hold the cup, repeatedly urging him to drink it dry.

units.source_text: 柏木无可奈何，困窘不堪，那神态异常优美。

en.t: Kashiwagi had no choice and was painfully embarrassed, yet his demeanor was extraordinarily graceful.
